arguments.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Production raster sprite source for HARVEST THE NIGHT. Create candidate A of the A054 Winter Lord, a towering final boss of ice. Side view facing west (left) in the game's three-quarter camera. A tall gaunt undead lord, jagged icicle crown, pale blue-grey frozen face and beard, heavy layered deep winter-blue robe with frost-white fur collar and hem, ice plates on shoulders, long staff topped with an ice crystal held low at its side. Hints of rot green only at cuffs. Matte ice, no glow, aura, snow particles or ground. Input 1: approved pixel-art style only. Input 2: Giant boss size/palette only, not its shape. Input 3: farmer size only. Native canvas 80x64, pivot (40,60), full unclipped silhouette about 40x50 and within 34-46 wide x46-52 high. Staff stays low enough that the later cast fits within 58px. Distinct from ordinary zombies; strongest boss of the year. Crisp pixel art, colored outline, simple readable material planes, restrained clusters. Transparent background, no shadow. No text, UI, extra objects, glow, blur, gradients, snow, halo, 3D or contact sheet.
